notes:
Three fixes, mostly for two tablets used together.

**New pieces no longer get stuck on their way to the second tablet.** Every day or two the tablet quietly changes the name it uses for its direct Wi-Fi link, and if that happened just as a piece was being sent, the two tablets could no longer find each other — until both apps were restarted. They now tell each other about the new name straight away.

**Closing a piece on the master now reliably closes it on the second tablet.** If the Bluetooth link dropped for a moment as you closed something, the second tablet never heard, and the piece stayed open there. The master now also sends its whole list of open pieces, so a missed close fixes itself.

**Writing near the right and bottom edges shows up as you write.** On the second tablet — and on any tablet writing with the sidebar hidden — ink in a strip along the right and bottom edges was saved but only appeared after leaving edit mode. It now appears live, right up to the edge.
